newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy treasury gives ENI share prices.
newsitem.headline: Italy treasury gives ENI share prices.

text.p: The Italian Treasury on Saturday announced that the second tranche of shares in energy giant ENI offered to investors would give private buyers a 3.5 percent price discount to the price paid by institutions.
It also said in a statement the highest price the shares would be offered to instututions would be 7,425 lire (US$4.85) per share. The actual price would be announced next weekend.
The statement said the second tranche placement of about 700 million shares would cut the Treasury's stake in ENI to 76 percent from 85 percent.
It is the first time in Italy the shares are be offered to Italian retail investors at a discount.
